chapterInfo.content:
2
Yesu Kristo sraani nokwafoɔ
1Afei wo, me ba, yɛ den adom a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no mu! 2Na deɛ wote firii m’anomu, adansefoɔ bebree anim no, ɛno ara na fa hyɛ nnipa anokwafoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akyerɛkyerɛ ebinom nso nsa.
3 # 2 Ti 1.8; 4.5 Na wo nso, mia w’ani hunu amane sɛ Kristo Yesu sraani pa. 4Obi nkɔ ɔsa mfa daadaa asetena mu nsɛm mmarebare ne ho, na wasɔ ɔsahene ani. 5#2 Ti 4.8 Na sɛ obi si akan nso a, wɔmmɔ no nkonim abotire, gye sɛ wasi no sɛdeɛ ɛho mmara teɛ. 6#1 Ko 9.7 Okuafoɔ a ɔyɛ adwuma na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔnya mu aba no bi kane. 7Hunu deɛ meseɛ yi, na Awurade bɛma wo ade nyinaa mu nteaseɛ.
8 # 1 Ko 15.4; 15.20; 2 Sa 7.12 Kae Yesu Kristo a ɔsɔre firii awufoɔ mu a ɔfiri Dawid aseɛ, sɛdeɛ m’asɛmpa no teɛ no. 9#Efe 3.1; 3.13; Flp 2.17; 1.12-14 Ɛno mu na mehunu amane bɛduru ɔkyerɛ mu sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ, nanso Nyankopɔn asɛm deɛ, wɔnkyeree no. 10#Kol 1.24 Yei nti meto me bo ase amaneɛ nyinaa mu, wɔn a wɔayi wɔn no nti, na wɔn nso anya nkwagyeɛ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no ne daa animuonyam.
Asɛnnua ne abotire
11 # 2 Ko 4.11 Nokwasɛm nie:
Sɛ yɛne no awu a, yɛne no bɛtena ase nso.
12 # Mat 10.33 Sɛ yɛgyina pintinn a, yɛne no bɛdi hene.
Sɛ yɛpa no a, ɔno nso bɛpa yɛn.
13 # Rom 3.2-3; Num 23.19 Sɛ yɛnyɛ anokwafoɔ a, ɔno deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ ara,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔntumi mpa ne ho akyi.
Odwumayɛni a ɔsɔ Onyankopɔn ani
14 # 1 Ti 6.4; Tito 3.9 Yeinom na kae wɔn, na di wɔn adanseɛ Nyankopɔn anim, na wɔannye nsɛm ho akyinnyeɛ hunu a mfasoɔ biara nni so, a ɛsɛe atiefoɔ adwene.
15 # 1 Ti 4.6; Tito 2.7-8 Bɔ mmɔden gyina Nyankopɔn anim sɛdeɛ ɔfata, sɛ odwumayɛni a ɛnni sɛ ɔfɛreɛ, na ɔpɛɛpɛɛ nokwasɛm no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ. 16#1 Ti 4.7 Na nsɛnhuhuo a ɛho nteɛ no deɛ, yi wo ho firi ho, na wɔbɛkɔ wɔn anim ara mmusubɔ mu, 17#1 Ti 1.20 na wɔn asɛm bɛyerɛ sɛ yare bɔne; na wɔn mu bi ne Himeneo ne Fileto 18a wɔapae afiri nokorɛ no ho reka sɛ owusɔreɛ atwam, na wɔdane binom gyidie butuo.
19 # Yoh 10.14 Nanso Nyankopɔn nnyinasoɔ tim hɔ pintinn kura nsɔano yi: Awurade nim wɔn a wɔyɛ ne deɛ; ɛne: Ma obiara a ɔbɔ Awurade din ntwe ne ho mfiri deɛ ɛntene ho.
20Na efie kɛseɛ mu nni sika ne dwetɛ nnoɔma nko, na nnua ne dɔteɛ deɛ nso wɔ mu bi, na wɔbu bi, na ebi nso yɛ deɛ wɔmmuo. 21Na sɛ obi te ne ho firi yeinom ho a, ɔbɛyɛ adeɛ a wɔbuo, na wɔate ho a, owura no de yɛ biribi a, ɛyɛ yie, na wɔasiesie de reyɛ adwuma pa biara.
22 # 1 Ti 6.11 Dwane firi mmabunuberɛ mu akɔnnɔ ho, na di tenenee, gyidie, ɔdɔ ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛka wo ne wɔn a wɔfiri akoma a emu teɛ mu frɛ Awurade bɔ mu no akyi. 23#1 Ti 4.7 Na nkwasea akyinnyegyeɛ a wɔmfa nsua hwee no deɛ, gu, ɛfiri sɛ wonim sɛ, ɛde ntɔkwa ba. 24#Tito 1.7 Na ɛnsɛ Awurade akoa bi sɛ ɔyɛ ntɔkwapɛfoɔ, na mmom ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdwo ma nnipa nyinaa, ɔhunu nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔto ne bo ase bɔne ho, 25na ɔde ɔdwoɔ kasa kyerɛ wɔn a wɔne no di asie wɔ nsɛm mu, sɛ ebia Onyankopɔn bɛma wɔn adwensakyera akɔ nokorɛ no hunu mu, 26na wɔn ani so atete afiri ɔbonsam a wakyere wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ no afidie mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Afei wo, me ba, yɛ den adom a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no mu! Na deɛ wote firii m’anomu, adansefoɔ bebree anim no, ɛno ara na fa hyɛ nnipa anokwafoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akyerɛkyerɛ ebinom nso nsa.
Na wo nso, mia w’ani hunu amane sɛ Kristo Yesu sraani pa. Obi nkɔ ɔsa mfa daadaa asetena mu nsɛm mmarebare ne ho, na wasɔ ɔsahene ani. Na sɛ obi si akan nso a, wɔmmɔ no nkonim abotire, gye sɛ wasi no sɛdeɛ ɛho mmara teɛ. Okuafoɔ a ɔyɛ adwuma na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔnya mu aba no bi kane. Hunu deɛ meseɛ yi, na Awurade bɛma wo ade nyinaa mu nteaseɛ.
Kae Yesu Kristo a ɔsɔre firii awufoɔ mu a ɔfiri Dawid aseɛ, sɛdeɛ m’asɛmpa no teɛ no. Ɛno mu na mehunu amane bɛduru ɔkyerɛ mu sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ, nanso Nyankopɔn asɛm deɛ, wɔnkyeree no. Yei nti meto me bo ase amaneɛ nyinaa mu, wɔn a wɔayi wɔn no nti, na wɔn nso anya nkwagyeɛ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu no ne daa animuonyam.

Nokwasɛm nie:
Sɛ yɛne no awu a, yɛne no bɛtena ase nso.
Sɛ yɛgyina pintinn a, yɛne no bɛdi hene.
Sɛ yɛpa no a, ɔno nso bɛpa yɛn.
Sɛ yɛnyɛ anokwafoɔ a, ɔno deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ ara,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔntumi mpa ne ho akyi.


Yeinom na kae wɔn, na di wɔn adanseɛ Nyankopɔn anim, na wɔannye nsɛm ho akyinnyeɛ hunu a mfasoɔ biara nni so, a ɛsɛe atiefoɔ adwene.
Bɔ mmɔden gyina Nyankopɔn anim sɛdeɛ ɔfata, sɛ odwumayɛni a ɛnni sɛ ɔfɛreɛ, na ɔpɛɛpɛɛ nokwasɛm no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na nsɛnhuhuo a ɛho nteɛ no deɛ, yi wo ho firi ho, na wɔbɛkɔ wɔn anim ara mmusubɔ mu, na wɔn asɛm bɛyerɛ sɛ yare bɔne; na wɔn mu bi ne Himeneo ne Fileto a wɔapae afiri nokorɛ no ho reka sɛ owusɔreɛ atwam, na wɔdane binom gyidie butuo.
Nanso Nyankopɔn nnyinasoɔ tim hɔ pintinn kura nsɔano yi: Awurade nim wɔn a wɔyɛ ne deɛ; ɛne: Ma obiara a ɔbɔ Awurade din ntwe ne ho mfiri deɛ ɛntene ho.
Na efie kɛseɛ mu nni sika ne dwetɛ nnoɔma nko, na nnua ne dɔteɛ deɛ nso wɔ mu bi, na wɔbu bi, na ebi nso yɛ deɛ wɔmmuo. Na sɛ obi te ne ho firi yeinom ho a, ɔbɛyɛ adeɛ a wɔbuo, na wɔate ho a, owura no de yɛ biribi a, ɛyɛ yie, na wɔasiesie de reyɛ adwuma pa biara.
Dwane firi mmabunuberɛ mu akɔnnɔ ho, na di tenenee, gyidie, ɔdɔ ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛka wo ne wɔn a wɔfiri akoma a emu teɛ mu frɛ Awurade bɔ mu no akyi. Na nkwasea akyinnyegyeɛ a wɔmfa nsua hwee no deɛ, gu, ɛfiri sɛ wonim sɛ, ɛde ntɔkwa ba. Na ɛnsɛ Awurade akoa bi sɛ ɔyɛ ntɔkwapɛfoɔ, na mmom ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdwo ma nnipa nyinaa, ɔhunu nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔto ne bo ase bɔne ho, na ɔde ɔdwoɔ kasa kyerɛ wɔn a wɔne no di asie wɔ nsɛm mu, sɛ ebia Onyankopɔn bɛma wɔn adwensakyera akɔ nokorɛ no hunu mu, na wɔn ani so atete afiri ɔbonsam a wakyere wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ no afidie mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
